# TheBhom.in (Full Documentation)

> TheBhom.in is a premier Indian platform for curated online shopping deals, flash sale price-drop tracking, and expert consumer tech buying guides.

## Architecture & Overview

TheBhom is built for high speed, zero latency, and privacy-first web performance. The platform is organized into two core editorial and commercial divisions:

1. **TheBhom Deals Store (`/deals/`)**: Handpicked discount deals and price drop tracking for Flipkart, Myntra, and Ajio, plus direct live links for Amazon India. Amazon pricing is not included in price tracking/graph, and we do not issue alerts for any products through Amazon.
2. **Guides & Editorial Reviews Hub (`/guides/`)**: 30+ comprehensive, in-depth expert consumer buying guides, smartphone processor rankings, OLED display guides, laptop comparisons, smart home guides, and online shopping safety checklists.
